messages.content: What does unified memory mean on Apple silicon?
CPU and GPU share one physical memory pool, so a tensor does not have to be copied across a bus before the GPU can read it. For inference this removes host-to-device transfer entirely.
Why is a 4-bit model faster than an 8-bit one?
Generation is bound by memory bandwidth, not arithmetic. Halving the bytes per weight halves the data read per token, so throughput roughly doubles.
When should I fine-tune instead of using a longer prompt?
Fine-tune when you need a consistent format or tone across many calls, or when the instructions no longer fit comfortably in the prompt. For facts that change, retrieval is the better tool.
LoRA adapters trained on top of a base model whose weights stay quantized. The frozen base stays small in memory while only the low-rank adapter matrices are updated in higher precision.
Does running a model locally send my prompts anywhere?
No. Inference reads static weight files and computes locally. Network access is only needed to download the weights in the first place.
